headline: Chicago O'Hare is running behind; flights into Seattle face a delay program.

items.text: Chicago O'Hare is the slowest United hub: 79% of departures so far today left within 30 minutes of schedule (460 departed). The other hubs are running normally.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub. Flights into Seattle are held by a ground delay program until 9:59 PM PT, with delays averaging 32 minutes, up to 82 minutes.
Tomorrow, the FAA's operations plan lists possible ground stops or delay programs at Boston, New York LaGuardia, Miami and San Diego; none is in effect now.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
